summary: Iteration_38 E2E verification for the 5 enhancements (peserta-mismatch warning + PaxCountBadge, PIC-change timeline entry, Bulk Pindah PIC, Regenerate/Edit/Delete invoice, invoice nominal = per_pax x traveler count). Backend pytest suite (8/8 PASS) covers: sales 403 on PUT /api/customers/{id} with sales_pic_id and on POST /api/customers/bulk-reassign-pic; POST /api/bookings/6a7ac3e26aad3a79a0844111/invoice → pax=1, subtotal 50,000,000, total 48,610,000; PUT /api/invoices/{iid} pax=3 per_pax=10jt → total 30,000,000 (verified with GET); POST /api/invoices/{iid}/regenerate reverts to pax=1 total 48,610,000; DELETE /api/invoices/{iid} → 400 when a payment exists (voided via POST /api/payments/{pid}/void for cleanup, then delete OK); PUT /api/customers/{cid} with sales_pic_id logs pic_change activity that surfaces as a 'PIC Sales diganti' entry in GET /api/customers/{cid}/360 timeline (kind=pic_change); POST /api/customers/bulk-reassign-pic reassigns and returns {reassigned:N}; auto-reverted. Frontend E2E (Playwright) as Super Admin: on /crm the select-all-customers header checkbox and per-row select-customer-* checkboxes are present, checking them shows bulk-action-bar with bulk-reassign-btn → opens bulk-pic-dialog with bulk-pic-select + bulk-pic-save; Customer 360 (/crm/6a7a88415cad6f678e729b10) shows change-pic-btn → change-pic-dialog with pic-select + pic-save-btn; tab-timeline contains 'PIC Sales diganti'. BookingDetail (/booking/6a7ac3e26aad3a79a0844111) Peserta tab shows pax-count-badge, Invoice & Payment tab shows invoice-pax-warning banner ('Jumlah peserta terdaftar (1) berbeda dari pax booking (2). Invoice dihitung sesuai jumlah peserta terdaftar.') + create-invoice-button + invoice-regenerate-* + invoice-edit-* + invoice-delete-* on each row; invoice-edit opens edit-invoice-dialog with edit-inv-pax/perpax/total/save. As Sales user: no select-all/row checkboxes on /crm, no change-pic-btn on Customer 360, no invoice-edit/delete/regenerate/create-invoice buttons on BookingDetail.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 8751 lines — refactor recommended (split invoices, customers, PIC endpoints into separate routers).
delete_invoice blocks on paid_amount>0 OR any non-VOID payment; good. Consider surfacing a friendlier UI toast in BookingDetail Delete confirm to mention 'VOID pembayaran terlebih dahulu'.

update_invoice preserves discount_percent by re-deriving from discount_amount/subtotal; correct but note that if discount_percent was originally provided by user and rounds to a different value, it will drift. Acceptable for MVP.
regenerate_invoice does not update terms/due_date; only recomputes amounts+pax — matches spec.
_booking_invoice_amounts fallback to booking.pax when no travelers is consistent with create_invoice branch — good.
